stories.title: Is the Bill Belichick era at North Carolina already coming to a close?
stories.summary: As Belichick enters Year 2 at the helm of UNC, the end could already be in sight.

stories.title: The top sights and sounds from North Carolina vs. TCU in Ireland
stories.summary: For the fifth straight year, major college football will open with a Week 0 tilt abroad.

stories.title: Sources: TCU's top WR Dwyer out vs. Tar Heels
stories.summary: TCU wide receiver Jordan Dwyer will not play against North Carolina in Ireland due to a foot injury, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: Song KOs Nurmagomedov in massive UFC upset
stories.summary: Song Yadong pulled off a massive upset by knocking out heavily favored Umar Nurmagomedov in the men's bantamweight main event of UFC Fight Night in Shanghai.

stories.title: Skubal shines, tears up in emotional Detroit return
stories.summary: Dodgers lefty Tarik Skubal threw six strong innings and was brought to tears in his return to Comerica Park, acknowledging it was difficult to treat it as just another start.
